dashboard.label: SASP - Investigation Details
dashboard.description: Investigation feed and drill-down details for SASP AI-driven security investigations

search.query: index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation | stats avg(duration_seconds) AS avg_duration | eval avg_duration=round(avg_duration, 1)
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation | stats count(eval(guardian_approved="true")) AS approved, count AS total | eval pct=round(approved/total*100, 1) | fields pct
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation (severity="critical" OR severity="high") | stats count

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | sort - _time | table _time investigation_id model_name source_ip dest_ip severity triage_decision score top_features guardian_approved duration_seconds | rename _time AS "Time", investigation_id AS "Investigation ID", model_name AS "Model", source_ip AS "Source IP", dest_ip AS "Dest IP", severity AS "Severity", triage_decision AS "Triage", score AS "Score", top_features AS "Top Features", guardian_approved AS "Guardian OK", duration_seconds AS "Duration (s)"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | eval report=if(len(report_full)>0, report_full, report_summary) | table report | rename report AS "Investigation Report"
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | table triage_reasoning | rename triage_reasoning AS "Triage Reasoning"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | spath input=mitre_techniques | mvexpand {} | rename {} AS technique | table technique | rename technique AS "MITRE Technique"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | eval threat_actor=if(isnull(threat_actor) OR threat_actor="", "N/A", threat_actor) | fields threat_actor

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | eval kill_chain_phase=if(isnull(kill_chain_phase) OR kill_chain_phase="", "N/A", kill_chain_phase) | fields kill_chain_phase
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | fields severity
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | eval confidence=round(confidence, 2) | fields confidence

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | spath input=recommendations | mvexpand {} | rename {} AS recommendation | streamstats count AS "#" | table "#" recommendation | rename recommendation AS "Recommendation"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | spath input=affected_assets | rename {} AS asset | spath input=affected_users | rename {} AS user | eval assets=mvjoin(asset, ", "), users=mvjoin(user, ", ") | eval assets=if(isnull(assets) OR assets="", "None identified", assets) | eval users=if(isnull(users) OR users="", "None identified", users) | table assets users | rename assets AS "Affected Assets", users AS "Affected Users"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | table guardian_approved guardian_concerns | rename guardian_approved AS "Approved", guardian_concerns AS "Concerns"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | spath input=guardian_checks output=gc_keys | spath input=guardian_checks | table guardian_checks.* | transpose 0 column_name="Check" header_field="column" | rename "row 1" AS "Result"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | table detection_id model_name source_ip dest_ip score username calling_station_id top_features triage_decision | rename detection_id AS "Detection ID", model_name AS "Model", source_ip AS "Source IP", dest_ip AS "Dest IP", score AS "Score", username AS "Username", calling_station_id AS "Calling Station", top_features AS "Top Features", triage_decision AS "Triage Decision"
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation investigation_id="$investigation_id$" | head 1 | spath input=iocs | mvexpand {} | rename {} AS ioc | table ioc | rename ioc AS "IOC"
